decision.reason: [ev-d1948f134793] states only that the TCP LoadBalancer terminationDelay option was removed and is now configured on TCPServersTransport, pointing to documentation that is not shown; it does not say what happens to configurations still setting it (ignored vs. error), so the consequence cannot be written. The subject mapping is also unresolved: the CRD schema validator shows IngressRouteTCP spec.routes[].services[].terminationDelay is still present in the v3.0.0 schema [ev-f7d1f0ce407c] as in v2.11.2 [ev-caea0ddc58f9], so the evidence does not establish which configuration surface (file/dynamic loadBalancer vs. CRD field) actually lost the option. Needed: the linked terminationDelay documentation or v3.0.0 code/config-reference evidence showing the removed surface and its handling of leftover values.
